one_liner: Mid-level VA contracting officer role: run federal procurements under the FAR/VAAR, from market research and solicitations through negotiation, award, and contract administration.
fit_summary: This GS-12 job requires one year of specialized experience at the GS-11 level doing hands-on contracting work, such as recommending contract types, evaluating vendor proposals, and determining vendor responsibility. Daniel's IEM consulting background was most likely on the contractor side of government work, which is not the same as running acquisitions. Unless Daniel's actual IEM duties included proposal pricing, contract compliance, or acquisition support at a substantial level, Daniel probably will not meet the specialized experience bar.
eligibility: Open to the public (U.S. citizens), with ICTAP/CTAP priority for displaced VA employees; no federal status is required.
1102 basic requirement: a bachelor's degree in any field OR 24 semester hours in accounting, business, finance, law, contracts, economics, or similar fields. You must submit a transcript.
One year of full-time specialized experience equivalent to GS-11 in contracting work: contract type selection, FAR/policy application, vendor submission review, and responsibility determinations.
You must pass the USA Hire online assessment cut score, complete a financial disclosure, pass a background investigation, and present REAL ID-compliant identification.
Work is on site at VA-owned or leased space within the commuting area of the listed procurement offices. PCS and relocation are not paid.
strategy: Before applying, write down honestly what Daniel did at IEM. Apply only if that work included tasks matching the GS-11 examples, such as writing or pricing proposals under FAR-based contracts, tracking contract deliverables and compliance, or reviewing subcontractor or vendor submissions.
If Daniel's contract work is real but lighter, target GS-1102-07/09 contract specialist or VA Acquisition Academy intern roles instead, which build the specialized experience this job needs.

On the two-page resume, list the IEM title, month/year dates, and hours per week. Describe only concrete acquisition-related tasks using the posting's terms, such as FAR, statements of work, cost and price analysis, and contract compliance.

Answer the self-assessment questionnaire conservatively. The posting warns that overstating experience can remove you from consideration, and the specialist will check your answers against your resume.
Because this is an open continuous announcement, applying by the first September 8, 2026 cut-off gives the best chance of referral.
Prepare for USA Hire by practicing reading comprehension and reasoning questions. Daniel's interpersonal and negotiation strengths fit competencies like Influencing/Negotiating and Customer Service.
resume_bullets: Supported [number] government contracts valued at [$ amount] for [client agency] by tracking deliverables, monitoring compliance with contract terms, and coordinating modifications with [contracting officer/client].
Prepared [cost/price proposal sections or labor-hour estimates] for [number] responses to federal solicitations, interpreting statements of work and FAR clauses to ensure compliance.
Reviewed [vendor/subcontractor] submissions for [project] against [requirements], recommending [acceptance/corrective action] and documenting findings for [stakeholder].
interview_questions: Walk us through how you would decide between firm-fixed-price and cost-reimbursement contract types for a requirement.
How would you test whether a requested sole-source procurement is justified?
Describe a negotiation with a contractor or client where you had to protect the government's or your organization's position.
Tell us about a time a contractor was not meeting performance requirements and what you did about it.
watch_outs: The GS-11-level contracting experience requirement is a major hurdle given Daniel's likely contractor-side consulting background.
The job has no promotion potential, is not remote, and requires return-to-office compliance. The listed locations may not be within commuting range of Manassas.
Scoring below the USA Hire cut score or skipping the assessment ends your consideration automatically.
New hires serve a 1-year probationary period and must be certified in writing as advancing the public interest to stay employed.
